interactive_objects.description: Walls covered in tattoo designs. Skulls, tribal patterns, Looney Tunes characters, and... a suspicious number of birds.

easter_egg.reveal: You notice that Viktor's 'skull' designs all have beaks.

interactive_objects.description: A framed document on the wall. On closer inspection, it's clearly printed from a home computer. The 'official seal' is clip art. Expired 2019.
Polaroids of satisfied customers. They all have uncertain expressions. Several are covering their new tattoos with their hands.
interactive_objects.easter_egg: One photo shows a tattoo that's clearly meant to be an eagle but looks like a pelican.

interactive_objects.description: Suspiciously few entries. The ones that exist say things like 'Very... unique!' and 'I've never seen anything like it!' One just says 'WHY'.
A jar labeled 'For Brave Customers!' The lollipops are clearly very old.

visit_2.viktor_greeting: Ah! My favorite customer! The skeleton man! You want another?

post_other_city_viktor_encounter.viktor_greeting: You follow Viktor! Is fate! We do more art together!

narrator_commentary.on_entering: Euro Ink 4 Less. Where dreams become permanent, and skeletons become ducks.
narrator_commentary.on_sketch_reveal: Viktor presented his interpretation with the confidence of a man who has never been wrong about anything.
narrator_commentary.on_beak_question: Bradley, against all odds, had noticed something.
narrator_commentary.on_reveal: And there it was. A duck. Holding a scythe. Forever.
narrator_commentary.on_denial: Lord Pilsner's commitment to the bit was, in its own way, inspiring.
narrator_commentary.on_exit: Armed with his new 'authentic European art,' Lord Pilsner was ready to impress exactly zero waitresses.
